description_en: Queries the information about permission templates, including the template creator, template name, and total number of templates
description_zh: 调用ListAuthorityTemplate接口获取权限模板列表，包含模板创建者、模板名称、模板创建者及模板总数等信息
name: ListAuthorityTemplate

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for permission templates
parameters.help_zh: 填入权限模板名称关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

5
10
20
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示权限模板的数目。取值如下：

5
10
20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户的ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the permission template was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 权限模板的创建时间，时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the permission template

Description.description_en: The description of the permission template

Name.description_en: The name of the permission template

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the permission template

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。返回值如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of permission templates
